description: LoRA / QLoRA fine-tuning starter — PEFT adapters on top of a 4-bit-quantized base model via bitsandbytes, trained with TRL's SFTTrainer on a JSONL dataset. Ships a complete config-driven train.py, an infer.py that loads base + adapter, and a tiny sample dataset. For teams that want to customize a pretrained LLM without the memory footprint of full fine-tuning.

buildHints.whenToUse: Pick this when you need a custom model behavior (domain language, instruction style, task-specific format) but can't / won't run full fine-tuning. QLoRA 4-bit lets a 7B-8B model tune on a single 24GB GPU; 70B on a single 80GB GPU. For pure inference, use vllm-server / tgi-server / ollama-server. For RAG-style grounding without training, use rag-pipeline-py.
firstSteps: pip install -e . — installs peft, transformers, bitsandbytes, trl, accelerate, datasets
Replace data/sample.jsonl with your real training set (each line: {"messages": [{"role": ..., "content": ...}, ...]})
Edit config/train.yaml — base model id, lora_r/alpha, epochs, learning rate
Set HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN for gated base models (Llama, Mistral, Gemma)
gotchas: bitsandbytes 4-bit requires CUDA. There is no working CPU path for QLoRA — attempting this on a Mac silently falls back to fp16 and OOMs.
LoRA target_modules is model-architecture-specific. Llama uses ['q_proj','k_proj','v_proj','o_proj']; Gemma and Mistral differ. Copy the wrong list and training runs but adapters learn nothing.
lora_r above 64 stops helping and starts overfitting. lora_alpha = 2 * lora_r is the standard ratio.
Checkpoint sizes: LoRA adapters are 10-500MB. Full merged models are 14-30GB. Don't commit merged models; ship the adapter.
Gated base models need HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN AND license acceptance on the Hub — token alone 403s.
TRL's SFTTrainer expects either `text` or `messages` columns in the dataset. Mixing schemas in one file silently trains on the wrong field.
flash-attention-2 requires torch >= 2.1 and a SM >= 8.0 GPU (A100/H100). Older GPUs: set `attn_implementation: 'sdpa'` in config/train.yaml.

placeholders.description: data/sample.jsonl (replace with the real training set)
